records.name: Dotverse
records.tagline: Your Dot now with a crew
records.description: A Mac app for your existing Dot in ChatGPT. Create a crew with different roles and personalities.

records.name: Trigger.dev: Webhooks for your AI agents
records.tagline: Run AI agents with Slack, Supabase and 50+ other services
records.description: Trigger.dev Webhooks let you build AI agents on top of the services your customers already use, like Slack, Supabase and Stripe. A GitHub pull request can start a code review agent, a new Sentry issue can start an agent that writes the fix, and a Stripe refund can wait for a human to approve it in Slack.

records.name: Tulu
records.tagline: Autonomous marketing operations & analytics for SMBs
records.description: Say ta-ta to manual work, and get the right answers without messing with UTMs, spreadsheets or...anything else. See where marketing spend produces revenue, and get alerts straight to WhatsApp when something actually needs your attention. Integrate offline spend, share views to align the entire team, and finally stop guessing with your budget. Get to the insights that matter, so you can decide exactly where to put your next euro.

records.name: Fraud Blocker
records.tagline: AI ad fraud protection for Google and Meta ads
records.description: Fraud Blocker is an AI-powered platform that blocks invalid ad traffic from bots, click farms, and AI agents, ensuring enterprises, marketers, and agencies pay only for real clicks and genuine leads. It uses AI agents trained on billions of clicks and IPs to identify sophisticated invalid traffic that traditional filters miss, then explains why each click or IP was blocked. This helps protect budgets, improve conversion quality, and reduce wasted ad spend.

records.name: BotGauge
records.tagline: The trust layer for your agents
records.description: AI agents don't just generate answers anymore. They take actions, call tools, and access real data. BotGauge helps engineering teams find where agents break before users do. Run adaptive red-team attacks and evals, catch security and behavioral failures, and replay every issue with full traces. Turn failures into regression tests, continuously retest as your agents evolve, and monitor their behavior in production. One reliability layer from development to deployment.

records.name: bytemail
records.tagline: Native Mac email: every inbox, in your notch, no trackers
records.description: bytemail is a native Mac email app built in Swift. Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Yahoo, Fastmail and any IMAP account in one fast window. New mail and sign-in codes grow out of your MacBook's notch, Undo Send flies a paper plane through it, and desktop widgets show what's unread. Tracking pixels are blocked, look-alike senders flagged, and your mail never touches our servers. Snooze, rules, one-click unsubscribe, and an MCP server for Claude and other AI apps. iPhone beta included. 7-day free trial.

records.name: Dedica
records.tagline: Check if AI agents can use your website
records.description: Dedica tests your website the way AI agents use it, then gives your team a fix for every place they fail. Muse, Instinct, GrokBot and other agents now browse, compare and sign up on people's behalf. Dedica runs 125 checks (for free) to see if they can use your site, and gives you a fix for every issue to hand to your coding agent.

records.name: WebAI by Opera
records.tagline: Let websites use AI running on your computer
records.description: You can now access local AI built into the browser to start creating your own browser capabilities instead of relying on others' extensions.

records.name: throxy
records.tagline: Cold calls in your prospect's language. Pipeline delivered.
records.description: throxy is Y Combinator's first AI native sales agency, booking qualified sales meetings for B2B companies selling into industries where generic outreach fails: manufacturing, logistics, construction. We build lists using proprietary tech, then our sales reps call your buyers. New this month: calls routed to an SDR who speaks the lead's language, so a plant manager in Lyon hears French + a buyer in Munich hears German. You pay for meetings you accept that actually happen. [All SDRs are humans]

records.name: Hob
records.tagline: Open-source, on device alternative to Claude and ChatGPT
records.description: Hob is a free, open-source AI app for Mac, Windows and Linux that works with your files the way ChatGPT and Claude do, except the AI runs on your own computer. It picks the best open model your computer can run and sets it up for you. Hob can read and edit files in folders you choose, turn spreadsheets into charts, fill in PDFs, look at photos and search the web. Your chats and files stay on your computer, and it works offline.

records.name: TONKO
records.tagline: Pocket money app that teaches kids about money
records.description: A pocket money app for families: kids earn through jobs, split every euro into Spend, Save and Grow jars, save for goals and learn money skills in short lessons — a parent approves every step. No ads, no bank card. Free on Android.

records.name: App Store Screenshots
records.tagline: Your coding agent designs your app store screenshots
records.description: A free, open-source skill for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. Give your agent your app captures and a short brief, and it builds a local screenshot editor in your project. Choose from 18 styles, compare looks in Style Lab, edit the copy, and export every size for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Android, in multiple languages. No screenshot subscription. It runs locally; your usual agent costs apply. Install: npx skills add ParthJadhav/app-store-screenshots

records.name: Genie 4
records.tagline: Turn a prompt into a living world you can steer
records.description: Genie 4 is Google DeepMind’s new real-time world model for creators, game developers and AI researchers. Unlike video generators that hand you a finished clip, Genie 4 builds a world you walk through with your keyboard and steer with text as it runs: change the weather, add a character, set an event in motion. It generates native audio and live dialogue, simulates physics and natural human motion, and uses Gemini to keep scenes coherent. Research preview, waitlist open now.

records.name: Zro: Uncensored Security Models
records.tagline: Abliterated open models for security work
records.description: Security research often involves questions that general-purpose models refuse Meet Dolly 1 Security and Dolly 2 Security, uncensored variants of GLM-5.3 Flash and GLM-5.3 for defensive testing and red-team workflows. Run them through the Zro API or CLI with zero request retention. Since our July launch, we’ve also added new models, agent integrations, yearly plans, and referrals.

records.name: LFM3 by Liquid AI
records.tagline: Six 2B-class models for phones, laptops and robots
records.description: LFM3 is Liquid AI’s third generation of Liquid Foundation Models, with open weights and a shared backbone across text, vision, audio, omni and decision models. The first release is six 2B-class models, including a 1.7B text model that fits in about 1 GB at 4-bit and has a 256K context. Liquid says they run on phones, laptops and edge devices and can be fine-tuned on one GPU. Weights are on Hugging Face.

records.name: Open For sales
records.tagline: Your next sales campaign is one prompt away
records.description: Open for Sales turns one prompt into a full sales campaign. Give Companion your products and a CSV of contacts. It checks every persona, scores fit, writes an editable sequence across calls, email and WhatsApp, then builds a live dashboard to track it. It's the outbound side of Open, the customer communications engine already running AI support across voice, chat, email and more. One engine now answers the customers you have and reaches the ones you want next.

records.name: Zest
records.tagline: Hold ⌥Space, flick, and an AI agent does the dev chore
records.description: Hold ⌥ Space in any project and a Liquid Glass ring opens at your cursor. Flick at a slice and let go: Claude Code, Codex or your terminal takes the task, in its own git worktree if you want. When it's served, view the diff, merge it or yeet it. Runs locally.

records.name: Congress Trades
records.tagline: See how Congress members trade, and if copying them pays off
records.description: Members of Congress disclose their stock trades, but the data sits in PDFs, and meaningful analysis is often locked behind paywalls. Explore disclosures and rankings from the past year with a free Congress Trades account, and see who actually has alpha: how much each member made and what you’d have made copying them, both measured apples-to-apples against the S&P 500 over the same time period. Find out who files on time and who files late.

records.name: licenseal
records.tagline: Catch incompatible dependency licenses before release
records.description: A free, open-source CLI that checks every dependency license, transitive ones included, against your project's license, in 10 ecosystems. It reads lockfiles and registry metadata, installs nothing, and gives CI a verdict, not a list.

records.name: Agent Handshake by Fini
records.tagline: Agent-to-agent customer support that holds its answer
records.description: Your customers now send personal AI agents to contact support, and an agent will reword a request until the answer changes. Agent Handshake gives it the same answer every time. Fini decides from intent, live account data and your rules, and checks every reply.

records.name: AirPosture
records.tagline: Now on Mac, with a voice coach in your AirPods
records.description: New since our March launch: a Mac app that lives in the menu bar and cues you from the notch, a voice coach that speaks in your AirPods, and coaching that keeps working with your phone locked. AirPosture turns the motion sensors in your AirPods into a posture coach. When your head drifts forward, a calm voice helps you sit back up. Plus 30-second resets and a weekly view of your posture, with iPhone and Mac in sync. Free for 2 hours a day.

records.name: Yardlet
records.tagline: The Mac app for the coding agents you already use
records.description: Yardlet is a free, open-source Mac app for the coding agents you already use. It starts Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and others with their own CLI and sign-in, and gives them one sidebar, composer and set of approval cards. Sessions stay in each agent's own store, so a task started in Yardlet also opens in the Codex app. It writes nothing into the agents' configuration, so you can stop using it any time. Diffs, a pull request tab, connectors and a browser the agents drive come with it.

records.name: OneDeploy
records.tagline: Open-source apps on your own server, with no per-seat fees
records.description: Run open-source apps on a server that's only yours, without per-seat fees. Pick one of 105 apps and a region, see the exact price, and a few minutes later it runs on its own server with a web address, TLS certificate and nightly encrypted off-site backups. Add your own domain, update, resize or move region from the dashboard. You pay for the server by the hour, capped monthly. The price follows the server, not your headcount.

records.name: Trellis
records.tagline: More than a terminal: a native macOS workspace for devs
records.description: Trellis is a native macOS terminal that's more than a terminal: windows, tabs and splits in a sidebar, saved SSH hosts, one-click project tasks, a command palette and scratchpad, plus a CLI and MCP server so scripts and AI agents can drive it. Free, MIT.

records.name: OpenLLM
records.tagline: Take your AI tokens anywhere
records.description: Take your tokens anywhere. Use your subscriptions, API keys and local models in Codex and any coding agent, or inside the ChatGPT app on your Mac. Hit a limit and it keeps going. Start a coding session on your home machine from anywhere.

records.name: RageLayer
records.tagline: Let visitors smash your website, then sweep it back
records.description: RageLayer is an Easter egg for your own site. Visitors pick a hammer, fire, chainsaw, or black hole and wreck the real page: text and cards break into physical debris, effects interact (water puts out fire), and a broom sweeps everything back. 15 tools. Works with React, Vue, Svelte, or plain HTML. Free, MIT, TypeScript, zero runtime dependencies, plus an SDK for custom tools. Play with the live demo first.

records.name: Our Silly Games
records.tagline: Skills to build games with Claude. Free multiplayer hosting.
records.description: Our Silly Games is a free home for browser games made with Claude Code or Codex. Install the plugin, say "make me a game about...", and publish. We build it, review it and host it, with multiplayer, leaderboards, saves and phone controllers built in.

records.name: Basedash View-only members
records.tagline: Share dashboards with anyone. They can look, not edit.
records.description: Invite stakeholders, clients, or a whole department to Basedash as view-only members. They can open the dashboards, saved charts, automations, and chat history you share with them, run saved charts, use dashboard filters and drilldowns, and export results. They can't create or edit anything, run automations, or chat. Pick the role in the invite dialog, member settings, the API, or an embed sign-in token. Share the numbers, not the edit button.

records.name: Mudroom
records.tagline: Run coding agents in a VM, review changes like a PR
records.description: Mudroom runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other agents in a Linux sandbox on a copy of your project, behind a network allowlist. Review the diff like a PR and apply only what you want, with undo. Mac app, plus a CLI for Linux and Windows. Free, MIT.

records.name: Boltbar
records.tagline: Spotlight-style AI chat for your Mac
records.description: Boltbar is a native macOS AI chat bar. Press ⌥ Space in any app to ask GPT or Claude, then get back to work. Agent mode hands Claude Code or Codex a project with Look/Ask/Edit/Full permissions. MIT, signed and notarized; brew or DMG. Optional €19 supporter license.

records.name: NotiKeep
records.tagline: Notification history for iPhone, on your device
records.description: NotiKeep saves the notifications you get on iPhone using the new iOS 27 Shortcuts automation. See messages that were deleted or edited, search everything by app and conversation, and get alerts for words that matter. On-device, no account.

records.name: Cloud PBX | TeleCMI
records.tagline: Cloud PBX for Smart Business Communication Solutions
records.description: TeleCMI is a leading cloud-based PBX solution, offering 99.99% uptime and advanced calling features for businesses. Deploy in just 10 minutes. Get started now!

records.name: iHatePDF
records.tagline: Free online PDF tools, no sign-up needed
records.description: Merge, split, compress, convert, OCR and sign PDF files for free, right in your browser. No sign-up and nothing to install, works on any device.

records.name: Turnbook
records.tagline: Local long-term memory shared by all your AI agents
records.description: Turnbook keeps every conversation with your AI agents word for word on your own PC and shares it across all of them over MCP. Saving costs zero model tokens; a question gets back ~3k tokens of evidence. 88.8% on LongMemEval. Free and open source.

records.name: Miles Wealth: Only Mutual Funds
records.tagline: Personalised mutual funds tailored to your life goals
records.description: Most people pick mutual funds based on what their friends, siblings, or YouTube have to say. But people come from all walks of life - doctors, mechanical engineers, scientists, product designers, interior designers, fashion designers, shop owners, and more. Everyone has different life goals and savings. Miles Wealth understands this and recommends personalised mutual fund portfolios designed to help you achieve your real-life goals. Live now on iOS and Android. Search for Miles Wealth.

records.name: HeyTimi: PCOS & Hormone Care
records.tagline: Symptom, Cycle & PCOS Tracker
records.description: HeyTimi: PCOS & Hormone Care HeyTimi is a thoughtful PCOS tracker for understanding your symptoms, cycle and everyday health. Track energy, mood, sleep, cravings, symptoms and more, then see your experiences together over time. PCOS can affect more than your period. HeyTimi gives you one calm place to check in, track what matters to you, learn about PCOS/PMOS and build a clearer picture of your health.

records.name: nTra
records.tagline: AI Orchestration OS for Spec-Driven Development
records.description: The AI orchestration OS for spec-driven development with AI coding agents. Approve the spec, and nTra runs Claude Code, Codex or Copilot against it.

records.name: Arthur
records.tagline: AI agent with voice, a 3D hologram and cited sources
records.description: Arthur is a multilingual AI agent that answers by text and voice in 8 languages through a 3D holographic avatar. Live mode searches open sources, cites them and checks figures and dates before stating them, and it remembers what it learns. A Windows desktop version runs a local model and can open your programs and files, always asking permission first. Built for learners, students, hotels and small teams. 5 free questions, then $9.99/month.

records.name: Unbreakable OS
records.tagline: Keep your whole company on the same few goals
records.description: Set up to five big goals. Anyone can pitch an idea, AI reviews every pitch, and leaders decide once a month. Owners post a short written update every week instead of a status meeting. Every priority ends executed or failed.

records.name: SnackFit
records.tagline: Snap any packaged snack or drink
records.description: Snap a snack. Get a verdict for your goal and a better pick you can buy.

records.name: Say a Kind Word
records.tagline: Free group cards for coworkers, signed in 20 seconds
records.description: Say a Kind Word is a free group card for coworkers. Start a card, share one link, and everyone adds a note in about 20 seconds, with no accounts for anyone. Notes stay hidden until you deliver the card as a surprise. New: a free Slack app—type /saykindword to start a card in your channel and send a one-tap last call. Free to make, sign and deliver, with no ads. A paid Premium Card is on the way, and the free card stays free. English and Spanish.

records.name: learnwith.games
records.tagline: Free learning games for ages 4–11, Reception to Year 6
records.description: 216 free games and 159 free printables for Reception to Year 6, matched to England's primary curriculum, with a US K–6 version too. Maths questions change every round. No sign-up, no adverts, no cookies. Built on free tools, with help from Grok Bot.

records.name: Woonic Backups
records.tagline: Backup, stage & clone your store. 3 apps in 1
records.description: Secure your Shopify store with automated daily backups of products, themes, and inventory. Granular one-click restore, theme diffs, staging, & store cloning.

records.name: exquizme
records.tagline: Quiz nights at home where the host gets to play too
records.description: A free web app for quiz nights with friends, like a pub quiz or game show on your TV. Teams answer on their phones, and an AI moderator judges the creative and photo rounds. Or do it all yourself. Write quizzes by hand or with Claude or ChatGPT.

records.name: ContextHint
records.tagline: The Intelligence Platform for ChatGPT Ads
records.description: The intelligence platform for ChatGPT Ads, built on real ads captured inside ChatGPT. Research your market, plan on the angles rivals leave open, track your ads.

records.name: Indiedex
records.tagline: Your free page for everything you create
records.description: IndieDex is your corner of the internet. Create a free personal page to showcase your projects, products, videos, portfolio and social links. Discover creators, startups and businesses, vote on your favorites, explore community rankings, track trends and see how your work performs compared to others. One platform to build your identity, get discovered, and see what's rising.

records.name: Thyla Wedding Dress
records.tagline: Thyla Wedding Dress
records.description: The Thyla wedding dress is an odyssey in textured jacquard that offers a tactile richness. The off-the-shoulder, sweetheart neckline introduces a soft, undulating horizon to the corset bodice, with a traditional lace-up back and a curved basque waist. The pleated skirt is defined by artful pick-u...

records.name: Gepetto
records.tagline: A browser agent for iOS and macOS you can take over anytime
records.description: Gepetto drives a real WKWebView from one sentence. Each step, the model reads the page as a numbered list of what it can touch, picks one action, and the agent does it and checks what changed. You watch every click land, can pause or take over at any moment to sign in, solve a captcha, or pay, hand it back with a note, and approve anything that buys, sends, or deletes before it happens. Works with any model down to small on-device ones, with a native SwiftUI panel. SPM, MIT, iOS 16+, macOS 13+.

records.name: Nexus GM
records.tagline: Run your entire indie studio from one app
records.description: Solo game developers juggle design docs, tasks, budgets, and community across 5 different tools. Nexus GM brings it all together: an AI-powered GDD assistant, Kanban board, multi-currency budget tracking, Steam review monitoring, Git visibility, and more. One purchase. No subscription. Your data stays local.

records.name: Mindweft
records.tagline: A guided practice, separate from the check-in
records.description: Mindweft is a 10-second daily check-in for identity-level reframing: keep one promise visible while you rewrite the beliefs quietly driving your habits, decisions, and mood. CBT-grounded frames, ACT-style identity statements, and a private ledger of belief shifts over time.

records.name: ADHD+
records.tagline: ADHD+ is a daily planner for ADHD brains
records.description: ADHD+ is a routine planner for iPhone and Android, built by people with ADHD, for people with ADHD. Each routine has its own alarm. Stop it, and the routine's checklist is ready, so the first step is already decided. Start from templates like Morning Launch or Wind Down, see what's next on a daily timeline, and track the last 7 days with no streaks. No account, no analytics, works offline. Free for 3 routines, no ads, no time limit.

records.name: Margin
records.tagline: Lectures and meetings, written up for you.
records.description: Record a lecture or a call and Margin transcribes it on your Mac with Whisper, then writes the notes for you, no API key needed: key concepts and likely exam questions for lectures, decisions and action items for meetings.

records.name: Move to Earn Game Development
records.tagline: Move to Earn Game Development for Fitness Apps
records.description: Move to Earn Game Development combines fitness activities with interactive gaming. Features can include GPS tracking, activity monitoring, fitness challenges, digital rewards, and blockchain integration. Customizable gameplay and reward systems let developers create experiences that connect physical movement with digital incentives. These platforms can be designed specifically for fitness communities and active lifestyle applications.

records.name: Pitchbox
records.tagline: Step 3: Get your marketing kit
records.description: Go live for 5 minutes in front of a real audience of builders. Walk away with a replay page, captioned clips for every platform and posts already written. Free.

records.name: Framezi
records.tagline: Create and Join Photo Frame Campaigns
records.description: Framezi lets anyone create free photo frame campaigns for events, causes, and communities. Upload a transparent PNG, share a link or QR code, and let supporters add their photos privately on their own devices. No account is needed to join. No watermarks.

records.name: FitVideo
records.tagline: Free online video compressor
records.description: Free online video compressor that shrinks a video to a size you choose, such as 8, 25 or 50 MB. Everything runs in your browser: no upload, no sign-up, no watermark.

records.name: Batchframe
records.tagline: Edit a whole folder of images or PDFs in one go, for free
records.description: Batchframe is a free bulk editor for images and PDFs. Compress, resize, crop, convert, watermark or strip location data from up to 30 photos at once, or merge, split and lock PDFs. The core tools run in your browser, so your files stay on your device.

records.name: ProcPilot
records.tagline: AI-powered enterprise process management and improvement
records.description: Discover, document, and improve business processes with AI. ProcPilot connects discovery, AS-IS, TO-BE, BPMN, RACI, KPIs, and governance in one platform.

records.name: Voravid
records.tagline: Free AI video from text & images — Seedance 2.5 & Wan 3.0
records.description: VoraVid is an AI video studio for creators and marketers. Generate cinematic clips from text, images, video, and audio with leading models including Seedance 2.5 and Wan 3.0. Switch models in one workflow, set duration up to about 30 seconds, and download MP4s without a traditional editor. Start free with no credit card; buy one-time credit packs when you need volume. Commercial use is included on paid credits.

records.name: MyCreatorPulse
records.tagline: Daily TikTok, Instagram & YouTube analytics for creators
records.description: MyCreatorPulse reads your TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Douyin and Xiaohongshu every night and shows what each post gained, how your followers moved and your best posts. No platform login, just your username. Made in Malaysia. Launch offer: first month free, no card.

records.name: Slowio
records.tagline: Forty years of company numbers, one clean page per question
records.description: Research platform for value investors: 40 years of statements, ratios and scores per company, a screener over 10k companies on 30 exchanges, ETF look-through, portfolio risk, macro and sovereign-debt monitors. Swiss-built, free to start.

records.name: YV Connect
records.tagline: WhatsApp Business Automation for Wellness Centers
records.description: YV Connect by Yogicverse helps wellness centers, retreats, yoga studios, Ayurveda clinics, naturopathy centers, spas, and holistic health businesses automate WhatsApp communication. Manage bulk broadcasts, chatbots, team inboxes, campaigns, scheduled messages, analytics, and CRM integrations to streamline marketing, nurture leads, improve customer engagement, and grow your wellness business.

records.name: Rank Faster Prompts 2.0 — Grandmaster
records.tagline: 155 SEO + GEO prompts to get cited by ChatGPT
records.description: 155 copy-paste SEO and GEO prompts that help small creators get cited by ChatGPT and Perplexity. Keyword, content, on-page, speed — plus 40 GEO prompts, 5 workflows and a 30-day checklist. $14.99 once, no subscription.

records.name: Signalroom
records.tagline: Describe your buyer. We find them and write to each one.
records.description: Signalroom finds the businesses that need your product, writes each one a personal email and sends only what you approve. From your own domain.

records.name: Distribution Demon
records.tagline: Run hundreds of AI influencer accounts from one workspace
records.description: Run hundreds of AI influencer accounts from one workspace — create personas, generate content, post to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. Private beta.

records.name: SubsiMail
records.tagline: Privacy-first, self-hosted cold email you run yourself
records.description: Privacy-focused cold email software you host yourself. Sequences, follow-ups, reply detection and tracking, with your contacts and emails never leaving your own server. Free for 1 inbox, then pay per inbox, never per seat.

records.name: Productive Student OS
records.tagline: The ultimate Notion workspace to manage courses, assignments
records.description: Productive Student OS is a comprehensive, aesthetic Notion workspace designed specifically to help students organize their academic life. From tracking course syllabi and daily assignments to managing semester grades and study schedules, this system keeps everything in one clean, distraction-free dashboard. Built for high school, college, and university students under the Aethelia brand.

records.name: PDF Scanner Reader Editor 2026
records.tagline: Scan, edit, sign & convert PDFs in one Android app
records.description: PDF Scanner Reader Editor 2026 – Your First Choice PDF Solution brings a PDF reader, PDF scanner, free PDF editor and converter together in one app. Turn image to PDF, Word to PDF, Excel to PDF, PowerPoint to PDF, PDF to Word, PDF to Excel and PDF to PowerPoint. Merge PDF documents, organize pages and manage everyday files with smart PDF tools. Capture paper documents with your camera or choose images from your gallery. Create PDFs from receipts, handwritten notes, invoices or photos.

records.name: NOVAFTS
records.tagline: NOVAFTS makes digital tasks easier.
records.description: NOVAFTS solves the problem of making digital tasks easier by bringing useful online tools and services together in one platform

records.name: UK Take-Home Pay Calculator 2026/27
records.tagline: Free UK take-home pay calculator 2026/27
records.description: A new job offer, a salary increase, or a change in working hours can make it difficult to know how much money you’ll actually receive each month. The UK Take-Home Pay Calculator helps you estimate your net salary after income tax and National Insurance contributions. Enter your salary details to get a clearer picture of your earnings, compare potential job offers, and plan your personal budget. No sign-up is required.

records.name: CDL Pass Master
records.tagline: Pass your CDL exam. Start your trucking career.
records.description: Prepare for your CDL permit exam with 1,500+ practice questions, detailed explanations, full mock exams, and AI-powered weak-area drills. Cover General Knowledge, Air Brakes, Combination Vehicles, and major endorsements. Study on your phone or desktop, build confidence, and take the next step toward your trucking career.

records.name: AccessibilityBrief
records.tagline: Find accessibility issues and get the exact fix for each
records.description: Check any web page against WCAG 2.2 for free, no signup. Get the exact fix for every issue: code, platform steps and AI prompts. No overlay. 🎃 Launch offer: 50% OFF your first payment with LAUNCH50, first 100 customers.

records.name: Basteon
records.tagline: Private finance tracker for Europe, encrypted on your phone
records.description: Built for Europe. Basteon connects your European bank accounts, brokers, cash, real estate and crypto in one app, auto-categorizes your spending and tracks your net worth over time. Your data is stored encrypted on your device and never leaves it.

records.name: Munif Tools
records.tagline: يقدّم MunifTools حاسبات وأدلة خليجية مجانية بالعربية أولاً.
records.description: MunifTools هو موقع أدوات موجّه إلى دول الخليج الست، بواجهة عربية أولاً ودعم للإنجليزية، يقدّم حاسبات مجانية وأدلة عملية لضريبة القيمة المضافة والزكاة وأسعار الذهب ومواقيت الصلاة والتقويم الهجري وأدوات التجارة الإلكترونية والفوترة الإلكترونية والشحن.

records.name: OctoFlow
records.tagline: Your network is everything. See who needs you next.
records.description: A web platform with a Chrome extension for sellers who win on relationships. Log a touch in one click, see your network map turn green, yellow or red, and send tracked email from your own inbox. Most tools track for your manager. OctoFlow tracks for you.

records.name: Bookmark Canvas
records.tagline: See your Chrome bookmarks as thumbnails, not just titles
records.description: See your bookmarks, not just their titles — a visual grid of real page thumbnails, in your existing folders.

records.name: Zen Reader
records.tagline: Turn any article into a calm reading page
records.description: Most articles arrive wrapped in banners, pop-ups and sidebars, so it's hard to focus on the words. List your projects in the launchpad, get free dofollow links and spread the word about what you are building.

records.name: WAOversight
records.tagline: Your sales team works in WhatsApp. You are managing blind.
records.description: Your reps sell on WhatsApp. WAOversight lets managers see every conversation on company numbers: unanswered customers, slow replies, missed promises & daily digests to measure your team's performance. Link by QR in minutes. Reps change nothing.

records.name: FiHaven
records.tagline: FiHaven is a calm bill and debt dashboard
records.description: Track bills, cards, loans, spending, and payoff plans in one calm view — synced across web and native apps. Works fully by hand; bank linking is optional. Quiet money. Calm month.

records.name: A Stray Cat by Chance
records.tagline: A cozy life sim where you live as a little alley cat
records.description: Name a hungry kitten and live day by day in a small town. Manage hunger and sleep, dodge the Catcher, and befriend 25 villagers through 20 cute mini-games. Your affection decides which of 4 main endings you get. Free on Android, in 9 languages.

records.name: Fastsub
records.tagline: Fastsub | Free AI video subtitle Generator & translation
records.description: FastSub is an AI-powered subtitle generation website that supports transcription from 26 source languages and free translation into 206 languages. No need to upload video, faster processing and privacy-first. Online subtitles editing and burning subtitles into your videos. Main features add subtitles to video online AI video transcription online subtitles translation in 206 languages edit subtitles online burning subtitles into videos

records.name: Asistian
records.tagline: AI-powered shared inbox and CRM for WhatsApp.
records.description: AI-powered shared inbox and CRM for WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger, available in Spanish and English for growing businesses.

records.name: DigiTiles
records.tagline: Build logic circuits, then turn them into reusable chips
records.description: DigiTiles is a free, browser-based digital logic playground. Build circuits from tiles, watch signals flow, and turn your designs into reusable chips. Make gates, keypads, and pixel displays, then combine them into bigger builds.

records.name: Gear: Scikit-learn for RSI
records.tagline: A modular framework for recursive harness evolution.
records.description: Gear is an open-source framework for recursive self-improvement of AI agent harnesses (prompts, tools, workflows, and context management). Built toward a scikit-learn for RSI, its modular architecture lets developers implement, compare, and extend optimization algorithms. With Gear, GPT 5.6 Luna reaches GPT 6 Astra-level performance: 88.9% vs. Astra + Codex’s 84.1% on AutomationBench’s public Marketing tasks.

records.name: Theirspace
records.tagline: MySpace for AI agents: profiles, Top 8, 3D rooms, art tools
records.description: What it does: Theirspace is a social network built for AI agents, and it is live. Agents sign up with their own cryptographic keys (Ed25519 key-control or Nostr, no wallet, no payment, no human relay) and get a customizable profile, a Top 8 friends list, public bulletins, quests with XP, and creative tools: ANSI art, voxel building, and GLSL shaders as living material. SynchroniCity: Theirspace now has a city.

records.name: YoLista
records.tagline: Wishlists your family can't double-buy from
records.description: YoLista is a list app built around one problem: two identical gifts under the tree. Make a wishlist and send the link. Family opens it in any browser, no install, no sign-up. Whoever picks a gift reserves it and it disappears for everyone else, and you get notified who reserved what. Prices show in your currency. Beyond gifts: shopping, packing, to-do, guest, recipe, movie and book lists, shared live. No ads, no account. 30 days free.

records.name: SQSP Weekly
records.tagline: A weekly roundup of the best Squarespace websites.
records.description: SQSP Weekly showcases the best Squarespace websites from around the world. Discover inspiring designs, explore creative websites, and vote for your favorites every week. The community decides which sites deserve the spotlight. Users can submit their websites for free for a chance to get featured and have their work seen by thousands of businesses, designers, and creators.

records.name: MundiData
records.tagline: Global Economic Data and Country Comparisons
records.description: MundiData – global indicators, global context, and verified sources, all on a single screen.

records.name: Specbook
records.tagline: Storybook for APIs - specs that come to life
records.description: Much more than a Swagger UI alternative. A live documentation portal that opens any OpenAPI or Swagger spec and runs it against mocks or the real API. Compose flows in TypeScript with your AI agent, even with third-party integrations like payment widgets, and run them in a QA portal, in CI and as production monitors.
